title: 6 Things God May Be Asking You to Release
paragraphs: 6 Things God May Be Asking You to Release

You keep praying for breakthrough…
but you’re still gripping what He told you to drop.
Listen.

Sometimes the miracle isn’t what God gives—
it’s what He takes out of your hands.

And that tension you feel?
That’s not punishment.
That’s invitation.

1. The version of you that survived—but never healed.
You learned to cope. To smile. To function.
But Jesus didn’t die just to make you manageable—He came to make you new. (2 Corinthians 5:17)

2. The relationship you keep forcing.
If you have to beg for love, manipulate for attention, or shrink to stay…
that’s not covenant. That’s captivity.
God doesn’t bless what’s breaking you.

3. The secret sin you’ve learned to hide well.
Nobody sees it. Nobody knows.
But it’s draining your authority.
“Whoever conceals sin does not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces finds mercy.” (Proverbs 28:13)
Mercy is waiting—but it requires release.

4. Your need to control everything.
You call it wisdom. God calls it fear.
Faith begins where control ends.
You don’t need all the answers—just obedience for the next step.

5. The offense you keep replaying.
They hurt you. Deeply.
But holding that pain is slowly poisoning your peace.
Forgiveness doesn’t excuse them—it frees you.

6. The calling you’re running from.
Yes, it’s heavy. Yes, it’s scary.
But what if the very thing you’re avoiding…
is the doorway to your purpose?
But here’s what we miss…

God never asks you to release something
without offering something better in return.

Not always easier.
But always deeper.
Always eternal.

At the cross, Jesus released His life—
so you could finally release your chains.

This is not about loss.
This is about exchange.

Your shame for His grace.
Your bondage for His freedom.
Your old life for His resurrection power.
So today—no more delay.
Drop it.
Bring it to Jesus.
And watch what He does with empty hands.
